plan: Define CheckInConsole class with __init__ storing appointments copy, session initial state, and optional source/sink.
Implement handle(action) to validate action type and fields, update session state, and return screen dict.
Implement screen builder methods for each prompt state, including error screens.
Implement run_once() to require source and sink, read action, handle, display, and return screen.
Ensure all public API and contract details are met.
mechanisms: State machine with explicit session fields and transition rules.
Centralized screen builder that derives prompt, messages, and choices from session state.
Validation layer that checks action type and required fields before mutating session.
Copy of appointments to prevent external mutation.
Standard library only, no external dependencies.
